meaning: To copy a file from the internet onto your own device. It could be a photo, an app, or a paper.
clues: It moves a file in one direction: toward you.
A copy travels from far away and lands on your device.
A progress bar often shows how much is left.
It is often the first step before you can open a new app or file.
It is one word with eight letters. It starts with D.
assumes: To upload is to send a file out to the internet
To install is to set up a program so it is ready to use
An email attachment is a file sent along with a message

decoys.meaning: To send a file from your device out to the internet.
To set up a program so it is ready to use on a device.
A file that travels along with an email message.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: I was the original download! Carry me between computers, copy the files, off you go. People called it sneakernet.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Tip: only open files you get from sites you trust. Check the file name before you open it.

why: It puts a copy of a file on your own device.
short: Copy a file onto your device
